name: taniwha
description: Compartmentalised, agent-driven build system for AI-generated codebases. Imposes structure that holds as projects grow, with verifier-checked contracts, a re-raise loop that surfaces under-specification before code is written, language-agnostic toolchain capture, and a contract-amendment fast-path. Uses Kupu's MCP backend when installed for atomic state operations, lighter agent context, full tree operations, artefact CRUD writes, structural validation, and dispatch metrics; falls back to bash scripts when not. Phase-aware detection means any Kupu phase installation (1-7) works seamlessly. v4.0 wires Phase 4-7 of Kupu (metrics, artefact writes, tree operations, validation) into the skills' action surface.

skills.name: design-doc
skills.description: Produce a structural design document from a brief, including the project's tier (single_module / small_multi_module / full_decomposition). Audits the brief for under-specification and surfaces every silent decision.

skills.name: contract-derivation
skills.description: Derive per-module contracts (manifests) and shared vocabulary from an approved design document. Manifests are language-neutral; sharing markers say which types must be canonical across modules.

skills.name: leaf-implementation
skills.description: Implement one module from one manifest, working only from the manifest, vocabulary, and project context. Refuses scope expansion; re-raises when the manifest is under-specified.

skills.name: composition
skills.description: Wire two completed children under a parent contract. Mechanical contract-to-contract routing; produces the canonical shared-types package when children share types.

skills.name: verifier
skills.description: Independently verify that an implementation or composition satisfies its contract's acceptance criteria. Reads the contract from scratch, writes its own tests, runs them, reports per-AC pass/fail.

skills.name: orchestrator
skills.description: Ephemeral subagent that decides the single next action in a Taniwha build by reading filesystem state. Holds no memory between invocations; all state lives in .taniwha/.

skills.name: dispatcher
skills.description: Main-session executor for a Taniwha build. Spawns subagents on the orchestrator's instructions; refuses to make build decisions itself.
